description: React component for user email preferences, allowing toggling of notification email settings with feature availability checks and loading state management.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Type for component props, containing a WebApplication instance.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a user setting and handles errors by alerting the user.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads user settings asynchronously and updates component state.

methods.name: toggleMuteSignInEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute state for sign-in notification emails and updates the setting.

methods.name: toggleMuteMarketingEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute state for marketing notification emails and updates the setting.
